oto.sektor: Türk devlet hastanesi, acil servis bekleme salonu
oto.esnaf_tarif: cheerful Turkish nurse in her 40s, light-blue nurse uniform, short dark-brown hair under a white nurse cap, reading glasses on a chain, no makeup drama
oto.fikir: Cemo acile 'çok acil durum' diye koşar. Hemşire ciddi ciddi semptomları sorar; Levent panikle tercüme eder. Punchline: acil durum Cemo'nun öğle yemeğini kaçırmasıdır, hemşire ona çantasından poğaça verir.
oto.notlar: Bu skeçte sponsor/reklam yok; sadece temiz mizah.

senaryo.aciklama: Cemo'nun acil durumu gerçekten çok acildi 😂 Sizce teşhis doğru mu?

planlar.metin: [whispers] Hemşire hanım, çok acil... kriz geldi!
planlar.gorsel: Inside a bright Turkish state hospital emergency room, Cemo bent over clutching his stomach at the nurse station, Levent seen from behind next to him.

planlar.metin: Sakin olun! Ağrı nerede, ne zamandır var?
planlar.gorsel: Same hospital emergency room, the nurse behind the nurse station desk, Cemo seen from behind in the foreground.

planlar.metin: [sighs] Sabahtan beri... midemde kocaman bir boşluk var.
planlar.gorsel: Same hospital emergency room, Cemo leaning on the nurse station desk, the nurse seen from behind.
Same hospital emergency room, the nurse listening to Cemo's belly with a stethoscope, Levent watching worried in the background.
planlar.hareket: the nurse presses a stethoscope on Cemo's belly and jumps back startled as his belly rumbles, Levent covers his mouth
planlar.efekt: very loud funny stomach growl rumble

planlar.metin: [laughs] Teşhis koydum: açlık. Tedavi: iki poğaça, günde üç kere.
planlar.gorsel: Same hospital emergency room, the nurse smiling and holding up a paper bag with two pastries, Cemo seen from behind.

planlar.metin: [excited] Hemşire hanım, ben bu hastanede yatmak istiyorum!
planlar.gorsel: Same hospital emergency room, Cemo beaming and hugging the pastry bag, the nurse seen from behind.
